_comment: n8n process consolidation cohort 2 (2026-10-16): the two Hermes learning consumers (discovery yield builder, tag-lift discovery) consume the VERIFIED completion of the learning stage, not a clock offset. Read by scripts/lib/learning_watermark.py (guard + reader) and scripts/report_learning_watermark.py (read-only report). The upstream watermark is the newest verified completion of step outcome_learning from either scheduler: (1) an n8n coordination-ledger RUN_DONE of upstream.lane_id whose receipt output_verdict is in upstream.require_verdict (the executor's verdict, the same rule as the registry run_done trigger), or (2) the cron runner's PipelineStepReceipt@v1 for the step (status ok, dry_run false) corroborated by the stage's durable file artifact (an outcome_bus history snapshot written inside the same stage run). Exit code alone never makes a watermark.

corroboration._why: outcome_feedback_agent writes state/hermes/outcome_bus_history/outcome_bus_<UTC YYYY-MM-DDTHHMM>_ofb_<id>.json inside the learn stage, before outcome_learning; a snapshot stamped within window_s before the outcome_learning step receipt proves the stage did work that run (tag-lift reads exactly this bus).

hermes-discovery-yield-builder.clock: hermes_overnight night stage step discovery_yield_builder (02:20 ET)

hermes-tag-lift-discovery.event_lane_blocked: OPERATOR DECISION: an n8n lane running scripts/hermes_tag_lift_discovery.py reaches broker_module / order_placement transitively (db_adapter -> holdings_guard -> schwab_position_sync -> schwab_transport, lazy). config/n8n_lane_capability_baseline.json is shrink-only and pinned to the operator's DD01 ruling of 2026-10-15 (tests/test_lane_transitive_capabilities_20261015.py FROZEN_20261015), so admitting this lane needs the operator to extend that ruling. Until then tag-lift is consumed by the watermark-guarded clock only.
hermes-tag-lift-discovery.clock: hermes_overnight night stage step tag_lift_discovery (02:20 ET, behind run_with_deepseek_offpeak.sh --official)

_event_trigger_state: shadow = the event lanes' dispatch mode is dry_run and their allowlist live_arg is null: an event fire runs --dry-run --learning-watermark event (reports the decision, writes nothing). Live is a separate operator-approved PR (live_arg + dispatch mode live + TRADEAI_N8N_RELAY_LIVE_LANES) after the shadow proof.
